description: If PA proves totality and uniqueness for the base and step arithmetic graphs, PA proves totality and uniqueness for their specified beta-coded primitive-recursion graph.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.recursion_total_unique {n : ℕ}
  (base : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin n ⊕ Unit))
  (step : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin (n + 2) ⊕ Unit))
  (hbase :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA
      (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.totalUnique base))
  (hstep :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA
      (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.totalUnique step)) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA
    (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.totalUnique
      (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.recursionGraph
        Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.betaGraph base step))
